original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州民间社会谴责朱巴-蒙德里公路伏击事件
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹西赤道州民间社会网络谴责在朱巴-蒙德里公路沿线针对平民旅客的武装袭击，并呼吁保护平民、查明失踪乘客下落。9月27日发生在蒙德里东县Lanyi与Lui之间的袭击中，两辆载有平民的车辆被烧毁，据称20余人遭绑架，部分妇女被强奸。地方官员称约32人被绑架，至少27人已获释，仍有数目不明者下落不明。警方已部署联合巡逻，尚未逮捕任何人，袭击动机仍不清楚。

location.site: Juba-Mundri Road, between Lanyi and Lui, Mundri East County
location.raw_text: along the Juba-Mundri Road ... between Lanyi and Lui in Mundri East County

key_facts.fact: 西赤道州民间社会网络谴责朱巴-蒙德里公路针对平民旅客的武装袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Western Equatoria State Civil Society Network has condemned an armed attack on civilian travelers along the Juba-Mundri Road

key_facts.fact: 最新袭击发生于9月27日，地点在蒙德里东县Lanyi与Lui之间
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The latest attack occurred on 27 September between Lanyi and Lui in Mundri East County.

key_facts.fact: 两辆载有平民的丰田陆地巡洋舰车辆遭袭击并被烧毁，据称20余人被绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: two Toyota Land Cruiser vehicles carrying civilian passengers were attacked and burned, while more than 20 people were reportedly abducted

key_facts.fact: 地方官员称约32人在伏击中遭绑架，至少27人已获释并被家人送往朱巴
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Local officials said about 32 people were abducted during the ambush. At least 27 have since been released and taken to Juba by their families

key_facts.fact: 警方已在该公路部署联合安全巡逻，尚未逮捕任何人，袭击动机仍不清楚
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The police said joint security patrols have been deployed along the road to protect civilians and travelers. No arrests had been made, and the motive for the attack remained unclear.

uncertainties: 被绑架人数说法不一：民间社会网络称20余人，地方官员称约32人
仍有数目不明者下落不明
部分获释者称遭殴打和酷刑、部分妇女称遭强奸，尚未获独立证实
目前仅一个来源（Radio Tamazuj），尚缺乏交叉验证
